newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Group shares plunge on planned bail-out news.
newsitem.headline: Kia Group shares plunge on planned bail-out news.

text.p: All six listed shares of South Korea's Kia Group went limit down in early afternoon trading on Tuesday on the news the nation's eighth-largest conglomerate had been tapped for a bail-out, brokers said.
Creditor banks to the group are due to officially announce details at 0530 GMT, a spokesman at the central bank told Reuters by telephone.
The flagship carmaker Kia Motors lost 1,100 won to 13,400 and commercial vehicle producer Asia Motors shed 300 won to 3,550.
Kisan shed 790 won to 9,110, Kia Service 500 won to 5,830, Kia Precision 580 won to 6,720 and Kia Steel 240 won to 2,840.
"Investors began dumping their holdings of Kia shares," said a Tongyang Securities broker.
